NvidiaMctpVdm.description: Nvidia device that implements an MCTP VDM protocol to provide sensor readings - implemented in dbus-sensors. Deprecated in favour of the per device kind types, which let a board describe more than one kind of device.

Name.description: A recognisable name for the device

PollRate.description: Poll the device at this rate, specified in milliseconds, to fetch sensors

NvidiaMctpVdmGpu.description: An Nvidia GPU that implements an MCTP VDM protocol to provide sensor readings - implemented in dbus-sensors

MctpConfigName.description: Name of the MCTP device configuration this record belongs to. Only needed when a board carries more than one record of this type, in which case consumers cannot tell them apart otherwise.
